request.style: English, deep male soul voice, piano, strings, bass, drum kit, gospel choir, reverent and urgent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the wilderness of Judea he appeared
Preaching repentance in the open air
The kingdom of heaven has come near
A voice calling out, the world draws near

[Chorus]
Prepare the way of the Lord
Make his paths straight for us to see
The spirit and the fire are near
Repent now, for the day is here

[Verse]
Camel hair and leather was his dress
Locusts and honey, no better rest
Jerusalem and Judea came
Baptized in Jordan, naming their shame

[Chorus]
Prepare the way of the Lord
Make his paths straight for us to see
The spirit and the fire are near
Repent now, for the day is here

[Verse]
Brood of vipers, flee the coming wrath
Produce fruit worthy of a fresh start
Abraham is not a shield of pride
God can raise children from stones inside

[Chorus]
Prepare the way of the Lord
Make his paths straight for us to see
The spirit and the fire are near
Repent now, for the day is here

[Bridge]
I am not worthy to carry his sandals
He is mightier than I can understand
Water for repentance is all I give
But the Spirit and Fire will live

[Outro]
Gather the wheat into the barn
Burn the chaff with unquenchable fire
The way is prepared
The Lord is near
